domain: A Curriculum, provenance and content governance
title: Content lifecycle with reviewer evidence
user_problem: Every item is UNREVIEWED_DRAFT; there is no path to reviewed, no record of who or when.

accessibility: Must keep keyboard operation, visible focus, 44px targets, lang attributes and the existing accessibility audit green

tests_needed: State-machine test; version immutability test; rollback test.
rationale: The review pipeline is the highest-value near-term item; code is the smaller half, the reviewer is the larger.
score_rationale: Value and safety are high; the reviewer is an external dependency.
